additional_code_like_files.effect_summary: Standard article/packages/macros and document output only; no shell escape, file-content include, Lua, or embedded executable code observed. URL/href commands render hyperlinks; no network fetch.

limitations: Static review does not execute the candidate, prove analytic claims, or validate historical receipt generation.
No claim of exhaustive detection under a malicious interpreter, standard library, dependency runtime, or hostile concurrent filesystem mutation.
All direct-run ancillary guards require their own pre-execution authentication; most are historical and lack current core isolation/startup policies.
Only observed packaged bytes are covered; external primary PDFs/corpora were not opened by this reviewer.
